# Spotify Wrapped-Inspired Design System

*Locked design system for the Spotify-like Recommendation Frontend. Generated by Hallmark. Do not edit token values directly — update this file and regenerate exports.*

---

## 1. Brand Foundation

### Brand Voice
- **Personal & Data-Driven** — speaks like your year in music, celebrating your unique taste
- **Vibrant & Energetic** — bold, confident, unapologetically colorful
- **Intimate** — feels like a gift made just for you, not a generic dashboard
- **Celebratory** — every interaction should feel rewarding

### Product Positioning
A music discovery experience that feels like Spotify Wrapped — personal, visual, and shareable. Users explore recommendations through the lens of their own taste profile, with genre "stories" and audio feature "top artists" style cards.

**Tone:** atmospheric / premium consumer. Dark mode default. Vibrant gradients. Motion-rich but purposeful.

---

## 2. Token System

### 2.1 Colour (OKLCH)

All colours declared as CSS custom properties. Scales use 9 steps (50–950) per Tailwind convention.

```css
:root {
  /* === Spotify Wrapped Gradient Anchors === */
  --color-wrapped-purple:  oklch(55% 0.25 290);   /* Primary brand purple */
  --color-wrapped-pink:    oklch(60% 0.22 340);   /* Secondary pink */
  --color-wrapped-green:   oklch(55% 0.20 145);   /* Accent green */
  --color-wrapped-orange:  oklch(65% 0.22 50);    /* Warm accent */
  --color-wrapped-blue:    oklch(50% 0.25 260);   /* Cool accent */

  /* === Semantic Aliases === */
  --color-primary: var(--color-wrapped-purple);
  --color-primary-hover: oklch(50% 0.23 290);
  --color-primary-active: oklch(45% 0.22 290);
  --color-primary-muted: oklch(90% 0.08 290 / 0.15);

  --color-secondary: var(--color-wrapped-pink);
  --color-secondary-hover: oklch(55% 0.20 340);
  --color-secondary-muted: oklch(92% 0.08 340 / 0.15);

  --color-accent: var(--color-wrapped-green);
  --color-accent-hover: oklch(50% 0.18 145);
  --color-accent-muted: oklch(90% 0.08 145 / 0.15);

  --color-warm: var(--color-wrapped-orange);
  --color-cool: var(--color-wrapped-blue);

  --color-destructive: oklch(55% 0.22 15);
  --color-destructive-hover: oklch(50% 0.20 15);
  --color-destructive-muted: oklch(92% 0.06 15 / 0.15);

  /* === Gradient Tokens (Spotify Wrapped signature) === */
  --gradient-hero: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-wrapped-purple) 0%, var(--color-wrapped-pink) 50%, var(--color-wrapped-orange) 100%);
  --gradient-card: linear-gradient(145deg, oklch(18% 0.02 280) 0%, oklch(14% 0.02 290) 100%);
  --gradient-card-hover: linear-gradient(145deg, oklch(22% 0.04 280) 0%, oklch(18% 0.04 290) 100%);
  --gradient-accent: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-wrapped-green), var(--color-wrapped-blue));
  --gradient-text: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-wrapped-pink), var(--color-wrapped-orange));

  /* === Neutral / Surface (Dark Mode Default) === */
  --color-paper: oklch(11% 0.01 280);         /* Deep background */
  --color-paper-1: oklch(14% 0.015 285);      /* Card background */
  --color-paper-2: oklch(18% 0.02 290);       /* Elevated / hover */
  --color-paper-3: oklch(24% 0.025 295);      /* Borders / dividers */

  --color-ink: oklch(98% 0 0);                /* Primary text */
  --color-ink-1: oklch(80% 0 0);              /* Secondary text */
  --color-ink-2: oklch(55% 0 0);              /* Muted / placeholder */
  --color-ink-3: oklch(40% 0 0);              /* Disabled */

  --color-border: var(--color-paper-3);
  --color-border-strong: oklch(30% 0.03 300);
  --color-focus: var(--color-wrapped-purple);

  /* Light mode (opt-in via .light on html) */
  .light {
    --color-paper: oklch(98% 0.005 280);
    --color-paper-1: oklch(100% 0 0);
    --color-paper-2: oklch(96% 0.01 285);
    --color-paper-3: oklch(90% 0.015 290);

    --color-ink: oklch(12% 0.01 280);
    --color-ink-1: oklch(30% 0.015 285);
    --color-ink-2: oklch(45% 0.02 290);
    --color-ink-3: oklch(55% 0.02 295);

    --color-border: var(--color-paper-3);
    --color-border-strong: oklch(85% 0.02 295);

    --gradient-card: linear-gradient(145deg, oklch(100% 0 0) 0%, oklch(97% 0.01 285) 100%);
    --gradient-card-hover: linear-gradient(145deg, oklch(98% 0.01 285) 0%, oklch(94% 0.02 290) 100%);
  }
}
```

### 2.2 Typography

```css
:root {
  /* Font families — Spotify uses Circular, we'll use a close free alternative */
  --font-display: "Space Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-body: "DM Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace;

  /* Type scale (rem, fluid where noted) */
  --text-xs: 0.7rem;       /* 11.2px — micro labels */
  --text-sm: 0.8125rem;    /* 13px — body small, meta */
  --text-base: 0.9375rem;  /* 15px — body default */
  --text-lg: 1.0625rem;    /* 17px — body large */
  --text-xl: 1.25rem;      /* 20px — section headings */
  --text-2xl: 1.5rem;      /* 24px — card titles */
  --text-3xl: 2rem;        /* 32px — stat numbers */
  --text-4xl: 3rem;        /* 48px — hero stats */
  --text-5xl: 4.5rem;      /* 72px — hero display (short) */
  --text-6xl: 6rem;        /* 96px — hero display (tiny) */

  /* Display scale */
  --text-display: var(--text-5xl);
  --text-display-s: var(--text-4xl);
  --text-display-xs: var(--text-3xl);

  /* Line heights */
  --leading-tight: 1.05;
  --leading-snug: 1.25;
  --leading-normal: 1.5;
  --leading-relaxed: 1.625;

  /* Font weights */
  --font-light: 300;
  --font-normal: 400;
  --font-medium: 500;
  --font-semibold: 600;
  --font-bold: 700;

  /* Measure */
  --measure-tight: 28ch;
  --measure-normal: 50ch;
  --measure-wide: 70ch;
}
```

**Pairing rules:**
- Display: Space Grotesk (semibold/bold) — headlines, stat numbers, hero
- Body: DM Sans (normal/medium) — all prose, UI labels, buttons
- Mono: JetBrains Mono — codes, IDs, technical values
- **Never italicise headings.** Emphasis via weight, gradient text, or drawn underline.

```css
  --radius-lg: 0.75rem;    /* 12px — cards */
  --radius-xl: 1rem;       /* 16px — feature cards */

  --radius-full: 9999px;   /* pills, avatars, stat circles */
```

### 2.5 Shadows / Depth

```css
:root {
  --shadow-xs: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3);
  --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.35);
  --shadow-md: 0 8px 24px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.4);
  --shadow-lg: 0 16px 48px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.45);
  --shadow-xl: 0 24px 64px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.5);

  /* Coloured glows for Wrapped feel */
  --glow-primary: 0 0 40px oklch(55% 0.25 290 / 0.3);
  --glow-accent: 0 0 30px oklch(55% 0.20 145 / 0.25);
  --glow-warm: 0 0 30px oklch(65% 0.22 50 / 0.25);
}
```

### 2.6 Motion

```css
:root {
  /* Durations */
  --dur-instant: 0ms;
  --dur-fast: 120ms;
  --dur-base: 200ms;
  --dur-slow: 350ms;
  --dur-slower: 500ms;
  --dur-ambient: 3000ms;  /* For ambient animations */

  /* Easings */
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);      /* default — exits, unfurl */
  --ease-in: cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.84, 0);       /* entrances */
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.87, 0, 0.13, 1);  /* transitions */
  --ease-spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); /* playful, stat count-up */
  --ease-elastic: cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55); /* bouncy reveals */

  /* Reduced motion */
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    :root {
      --dur-fast: 0ms;
      --dur-base: 0ms;
      --dur-slow: 0ms;
      --dur-slower: 0ms;
      --dur-ambient: 0ms;
    }
    *, *::before, *::after {
      animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    }
  }
}
```

**Motion primitives allowed (max 2 per page):**
- `counter` — number count-up on stat circles
- `reveal-up` — staggered fade+slide up on scroll
- `gradient-shift` — slow animated gradient on hero
- `card-lift` — subtle lift on hover (feature cards)
- `pulse-ring` — subtle pulse on primary CTAs

### 3.2 Stat Circle (Wrapped Signature)
```tsx
/* Circular stat display with gradient border and count-up animation */
.stat-circle {
  width: var(--size);
  height: var(--size);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--gradient-card);
  border: 3px solid transparent;
  background-origin: border-box;
  background-clip: content-box, border-box;
  /* Gradient border via mask trick */
}
```

### 3.3 Track Card
```tsx
/* Album-cover style card with genre badge, similarity ring */
.track-card {
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  background: var(--gradient-card);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out),
              box-shadow var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out),
              border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.track-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), var(--glow-primary);
  border-color: var(--color-border-strong);
}
```

### 3.4 Genre Story Card (Wrapped "Your Top Genres" style)
```tsx
/* Full-width story card with gradient background, large genre name, track count */
.genre-story {
  border-radius: var(--radius-2xl);
  padding: var(--space-8);
  background: var(--gradient-card);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.genre-story::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -50%;
  background: var(--gradient-hero);
  opacity: 0.08;
  animation: gradient-shift var(--dur-ambient) var(--ease-in-out) infinite alternate;
}
```

## 4. Page Templates

### 4.1 Home — "Your Wrapped" (Macrostructure: **Marquee Hero**)
**Sections:** Hero (animated gradient + stat circles) → Genre Stories (horizontal scroll) → Audio Aura (radar) → Top Recommendations (grid) → CTA
**Nav:** N5 Floating Pill | **Footer:** Ft1 Minimal

### 4.2 Genre Detail — "Genre Story" (Macrostructure: **Long Document**)
**Sections:** Hero (genre gradient banner) → Track Grid → Audio Feature Breakdown → Similar Genres
**Nav:** N5 Floating Pill | **Footer:** Ft1 Minimal

### 4.3 Search — "Discover" (Macrostructure: **Workbench**)
**Sections:** Search Hero (prominent input) → Results Grid → Filters Sidebar
**Nav:** N5 Floating Pill | **Footer:** Ft1 Minimal

### 4.4 Track Detail — "Song Page" (Macrostructure: **Marquee Hero** variant)
**Sections:** Hero (album art + gradient) → Audio Features (radar) → Similar Tracks → Artist Bio
**Nav:** N5 Floating Pill | **Footer:** Ft1 Minimal

---

## 5. Navigation & Footer Archetypes

### Nav: N5 Floating Pill (Customized)
- Pill-shaped, centered, max-w-5xl
- Items: Logo (left), Nav links (center), Theme toggle + Profile (right)
- Active: Gradient background + white text
- Hover: Subtle scale + glow

### Footer: Ft1 Minimal
- Single column, centered
- Brand statement + copyright
- No link columns

---

## 6. Motion & Interaction Rules

| Interaction | Recipe | Duration | Easing |
|-------------|--------|----------|--------|
| Button hover | scale(1.02) + glow | 120ms | ease-out |
| Button active | scale(0.98) | instant | — |
| Card hover | translateY(-4px) + glow | 200ms | ease-out |
| Stat circle reveal | count-up + ring draw | 800ms | ease-spring |
| Gradient shift | background-position | 3000ms | ease-in-out (infinite) |
| Staggered reveal | fade + translateY(20px) | 400ms | ease-out (stagger 80ms) |
| Page transition | cross-fade | 200ms | ease-in-out |

**Focus ring:** 3px solid var(--color-focus), offset 2px, never animated

---

## 7. Responsive Breakpoints

| Breakpoint | Width | Use |
|------------|-------|-----|
| Mobile | 320–374px | Single column, stacked stats, horizontal scroll for stories |
| Mobile LG | 375–413px | Same |
| Mobile XL | 414–767px | 2-col stats, stacked stories |
| Tablet | 768–1023px | 3-col stats, 2-col grid, side-by-side radar |
| Desktop | 1024–1439px | 4-col stats, 3-col grid, full layout |
| Desktop XL | 1440px+ | Max-width containers (1400px), generous spacing |

**Non-negotiables:**
- `html, body { overflow-x: clip; }`
- No two-line clickable text
- Grid tracks: `minmax(0, 1fr)` for image columns
- Headings: `overflow-wrap: anywhere; min-width: 0`

---

## 8. Accessibility

- Colour contrast: 4.5:1 minimum (all tokens verified against dark paper)
- Focus-visible on every interactive element
- ARIA labels on icon-only buttons
- Semantic HTML: `<main>`, `<nav>`, `<aside>`, `<header>`, `<footer>`, `<section>`
- Live regions for toast/status announcements
- Keyboard navigation: Tab → Enter/Space → Escape (close)
- Reduced motion respected globally (disables ambient animations)

## 11. Hallmark Stamp

